IT is hereby notified that I have in the exercise of powers vested in me under paragraph (5) of Article 44 of the Constitutionof the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, determined that with effect from November 30, 2015, the assignmentof Duties and Functions, Department, Statutory Institutions and Public Corporations to the State Minister of Industry andCommerce appointed under paragraph (1) of Article 44, to be as indicated in the Schedule given below.
RISHAD BATHIUDEEN,Minister of Industry and Commerce.Colombo,12th December 2015.SCHEDULE
1. State Minister of Industry and Commerce
Column IColumn IIColumn IIIDuties and FunctionsDepartments, Statutory,Law to be implementedInstitutions and PublicCorporation

1. Supervision of all industrial parks under thepurview of the Ministry and coordinate withindustrialist of each industrial park for thebetterment of industries.2. Identification of potential regions to establishnew industrial parks and provide informationand recommendation for the consideration ofthe honourable minister to launch newindustrial parks.3.
